title: Three-beep low battery warning
shortDescription: Shaver beeps three times when battery is near empty.
fullDescription:
Philips Norelco S9000 and OneBlade models beep three times with a flashing battery icon when under 10% charge. The shaver turns off after a few seconds.

Charge for at least 60 minutes (1 hour) for a full charge or use quick-charge if supported.

fixSteps.title: Connect charger
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in the Philips power cord.

fixSteps.title: Charge 1 hour
fixSteps.instruction: Wait for solid green charge indicator.

whenToCallPro: If runtime drops below 15 minutes after full charge.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Norelco S9000 low battery beep

faq.a: Only cord-shave models; most lose feature when plugged.

title: Charge LED flashes rapidly
shortDescription: Rapid flashing charger LED indicates voltage mismatch or bad contact.
fullDescription:
If the charge LED rapid-flashes instead of pulsing, the shaver is rejecting charger power. Causes include using a non-Philips 5V adapter on a 15V shaver, wet contacts, or a damaged jack.

Use only the original Philips cable and dry the base before charging.

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Check adapter output matches shaver (e.g., HQ8505).

fixSteps.title: Dry contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Towel-dry the base and leave air-drying for 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Retry charge
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in and check for steady pulse LED.

whenToCallPro: If the socket is loose or corroded.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Norelco charger flashing light fix

faq.q: Can I use a USB-C PD adapter?
faq.a: Only if model is USB-C rated (newer OneBlade).

title: SmartClean station reports cleaning error
shortDescription: Station icon red — cartridge, water level, or pump fault.
fullDescription:
The SmartClean Pro and Plus stations display a red error if the cleaning cartridge is empty, the shaver is not fully seated, or the pump draws air.

Replace the JC302 cartridge and reseat the shaver firmly.

fixSteps.title: Swap cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Insert new JC302 cartridge until it clicks.

fixSteps.title: Reseat shaver
fixSteps.instruction: Press shaver firmly into the dock until seated.

fixSteps.title: Prime pump
fixSteps.instruction: Run a clean cycle; if still error, tilt station and restart.

whenToCallPro: If error persists with new cartridge and correctly seated shaver.

faq.q: Can I use water in the cartridge slot?
faq.a: No, only JC302 cleaning fluid is compatible.

title: Shaver shows padlock icon and won't start
shortDescription: Hold power button 3 seconds to unlock.
fullDescription:
Philips Norelco S9000 and S7000 series include a travel lock engaged by holding power for 3 seconds. A padlock icon blinks when enabled.

Repeat the long-press to unlock.

fixSteps.title: Hold power 3 seconds
fixSteps.instruction: Press until padlock blinks and disappears.

faq.a: No, you must engage it deliberately.

title: Shaving heads replacement reminder
shortDescription: Replace icon appears every 2 years or 365 uses.
fullDescription:
Philips tracks usage and lights the replace-heads symbol after about two years of shaving. Install SH90, SH71, or appropriate genuine heads and reset the counter.

Reset by holding the power button for 7 seconds after installing new heads.

fixSteps.title: Order heads
fixSteps.instruction: S9000 uses SH90/91; S7000 uses SH71; OneBlade uses QP210/220.

fixSteps.title: Replace heads
fixSteps.instruction: Twist head holder open, swap cutters, close firmly.

fixSteps.title: Reset counter
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power ~7 seconds until icon clears.

videoSearchQuery: Philips Norelco replace shaving heads reset

faq.a: They often wear faster and may misalign.

title: Shaver does not respond to power button
shortDescription: Dead shaver — check battery, lock, and charger.
fullDescription:
If the shaver is completely unresponsive, verify travel lock is off, charge for 30 minutes, and confirm the charger LED pulses. Li-ion cells that deep-discharge below 2.5V may require an extended charge to 'wake' the BMS.

Leave on charge 2-4 hours before declaring a fault.

fixSteps.title: Unlock
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power 3 seconds to clear travel lock.

fixSteps.title: Try another outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Swap outlet and verify charger LED.

whenToCallPro: Dead unit after extended charge requires service.
videoSearchQuery: Philips Norelco wont turn on fix

title: OneBlade oscillates slowly or stalls
shortDescription: Dull blade, low battery, or hair buildup in blade slot.
fullDescription:
OneBlade uses a 200 Hz oscillating blade. If it stalls or slows, the most common cause is a blade past its 4-month life or hair packed into the blade retention groove.

Rinse blade under water, tap dry, and replace blade if 4 months old.

fixSteps.title: Clean blade
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse with blade attached for 30 seconds under running water.

fixSteps.title: Replace blade if old
fixSteps.instruction: Install QP210/220 blade; the counter dots on handle reset automatically.

whenToCallPro: If motor still stalls with new blade and full charge.

faq.q: How long does a blade last?

title: Erratic behavior after wet use
shortDescription: Internal moisture causing display or motor misbehavior.
fullDescription:
Though rated for wet use, Philips shavers can ingest water through a worn head seal. Symptoms include intermittent motor, scrambled display, or corrosion on the charging pins.

Air-dry for 48 hours head-down before attempting further use.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Use isopropyl alcohol on a cotton swab for charging pins.

fixSteps.title: Test cautiously
fixSteps.instruction: Charge, then test motor briefly; if faults persist contact Philips.

whenToCallPro: If symptoms persist after drying — service before further use.
